Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Stacy Harris is credited on 253 distinct recordings across 19 programs from 1944-03-05 through 1960-10-23. Documented roles include performer on 253 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are This Is Your FBI (performer on 162 recordings; 162 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 39 recordings; 39 distinct recordings), Frontier Gentleman (performer on 10 recordings; 10 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), The Line Up (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), Dragnet (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Workshop (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), and Gunsmoke (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings).
